purpose: COR-224 CrossOver NMS renderer variant (hedge for stock CrossOver MoltenVK)

build.configuration: ARCHS=x86_64, ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=NO, code signing disabled, GCC_PREPROCESSOR_DEFINITIONS += MVK_USE_METAL_PRIVATE_API=1
build.local_build_cache_note: APFS clone of the source-built pinned dependency cache moltenvk-1.4.2-x86_64-01 (cautious-potato), receipt identical

reproducibility: unsigned output is byte-identical to 170ca's MoltenVK 4b4bc6fe (calimocho-wine11.20-gptk4b3-tls-vulkan-private, owner-judged smooth for NMS) and to the unsigned input of the -06 release engine (signed there as f24fe64a); the signed bytes differ only by the code signature

signed_library.imports: system frameworks and /usr/lib/libc++ only; no /usr/local; no LC_RPATH
signed_library.signing: codesign --force --options runtime --timestamp --sign 410914520BCC840C0125D3826CCF0F247F603321 (Developer ID Application: Dragos Hont (M62Z4M5EUY)); no entitlements; not notarized (a bare dylib is not submitted)
codesign_dvvv: CodeDirectory v=20500 size=43703 flags=0x10000(runtime) hashes=1360+2 location=embedded

differences: environment.CX_LIBVULKAN and the CX_LIBVULKAN inside environment.CX_ENV -> signed library path

not_proven: NMS gameplay with this library under CrossOver (COR-224 run 2 variant)
loader_compatibility: CrossOver 26.3 Mach-O loaders bin/wineloader, lib/wine/x86_64-unix/wine and bin/wineserver are hardened-runtime with com.apple.security.cs.disable-library-validation=true (codesign -d --entitlements), so a Developer-ID-signed third-party MoltenVK is loadable; run 95ac8bdc already loaded an unsigned one via CX_LIBVULKAN.
